# How many employees does Mimica Automation have?

Mimica Automation Ltd. has approximately314 total employees worldwide as ofJune 2026, according to Revelio Labs workforce intelligence data.Mimica Automation’s total headcount has grown690.6% from 40 employees in 2023 to 314 in 2026.

Data source: Revelio Labs•Coverage: Global workforce, 2023–2026•Published August 2026

## Is Mimica Automation hiring right now?

Yes, Mimica Automation isactively hiring. Mimica Automation had30 active job postings in 2026, a 3.4% increase from 2025— [see job openings & hiring trends](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/mimica-automation/employees#postings).

## About Mimica Automation’s Workforce

Mimica Automation Ltd. is an Information Technology Services company founded in 2018 and headquartered in London, United Kingdom. It employs **314** people worldwide as of June 2026 and sits as the 6th-largest by headcount among its [peers](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/mimica-automation/employees#similar-companies).

Mimica Automation's workforce has expanded notably, growing **690.6%** from 2023 to 2026 and rising **19.1%** year over year in 2026. The largest share of employees is in Central America and the Caribbean ( **55.4%**), followed by North America ( **19.4%**) and Northern Europe ( **14.3%**).

Mimica Automation's groups are Finance and Operations ( **43.6%**), Engineering ( **30.8%**), and Sales and Marketing ( **25.6%**), with Finance and Operations growing the fastest (up **22.1%**). The average across all employees is **$63,712,** with regional medians ranging from **$119,000** in North America to **$22,000** in Central America and the Caribbean, and the overall pay trend is down **7.4%** year over year in 2026.

Mimica Automation's hiring activity shows momentum, with latest postings up **3.4%** in 2026 to **30** postings. Hiring velocity has risen in 2026, averaging **19** postings per month, matching 2025 levels and outpacing 2024 and 2023 figures.
